scope: Scientific review readiness only; not clinical certification

gates.title: Independent reviewer identity and conflict-of-interest disclosure
gates.acceptance: Independent scientific reviewer named, credentials and COI documented

gates.title: Full-text source appraisal and traceability
gates.acceptance: Primary studies and extraction decisions independently appraised

gates.title: Biomarker measurement and context validity
gates.acceptance: Units, phase, measurement method, confounders and missingness approved

gates.title: Directional relationships and temporal logic
gates.acceptance: Observed directions, time ordering and matched personal baseline validated; never infer inverse unmeasured changes

gates.title: Bone, immune, cardiovascular and behavioral domain review
gates.acceptance: Independent domain signoff; missing immune scientific mapping stays unapproved

gates.title: Synthetic versus real-world external validity
gates.acceptance: Independent assessment of transfer limits and simulated-data claims

gates.title: Non-diagnostic action and safety review
gates.acceptance: No clinical diagnosis, prediction or autonomous medical decisions

gates.title: Real-device and authenticated workflow acceptance
gates.acceptance: Real Crew Self and Researcher sessions and device evidence independently witnessed
